## Braid v0.1.0

Always-on fan-out orchestration for **OpenCode**, **Grok Build**, and **Claude Code**.

### Install

**Grok Build**
```
grok plugin install pdxxxx/braid#grok-plugin --trust
grok plugin enable braid
```

**Claude Code**
```
/plugin marketplace add pdxxxx/braid
/plugin install braid@braid
```

**OpenCode**
```
npm install github:pdxxxx/braid
# or after npm publish: npm install @pdxxxx/braid
```
opencode.json: `{ "plugin": ["@pdxxxx/braid"] }`

### Highlights
- Shared core + host adapters
- Default mode full; SessionStart re-inject (no re-arm ritual)
- Remote install surface (marketplace, #grok-plugin, npm package)
